notes.title: Fix for chatbox
notes.notes: Chatbox should only show now if you are in an online session.

notes.title: The Lore and Easy Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hopefully this will be the final update?

We added story to the game. It is inspired in artsy story games such as witness/Ikaruga even in hare I always try to do something different with story in games. And I'm trying to do some comic undertones. It's totally optional and you can turn it off on the game options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/0772270bcfed19f59c13dd8c92b847995254ecd2.png[/img]

Speaking of it, now we have translations for multiple languages (it, fr, ptbr, uk, ru,  zh-CN,  zh-TW, ja, ko, en | there are probably more that I'm not remembering right now).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/55ec3524100253f4b57b4ab767de545c42ea59db.png[/img]

All voice overs in the game have subtitles and I expect the subtitles to be localized aswell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/67d1049dde9ed43feea5662b8c46028d881be16c.png[/img]

Now the hat lady should speak in multiple languages before you're changing your hats! But now that I'm writing this I forgot to ask someone to dub her... F.

Star platforms are more predictable (now it only bounces you in 36 different directions which means it's less random but still random enough). And now it's actually possible to do this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/1b824985d55e6f084aa1ad5418c53ebc30076e39.gif[/img]

And last and most important. The main thing I got from people is that the game is TOO HARD! So I added an easy mode to the game. The easy mode gives you a cape which lets you float!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/41f7cf378d77c4897f825f8435fd6e78d0fb47ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/56b9bf35348027a47fe1d84847d8f59292947e4e.gif[/img]

I thought about doing some sort of time mechanics where you would go back in time or checkpoints systems where you could teleport to some locations but this defeats the purpose of the game. I may revisit this mechanics in the future, but I'm not sure I should do this.

Tried Double jump also, but it just breaks to much of the game. And at the end of the day floating is what makes more sense to make the game easier. So I hope this helps people exploring the game a little bit more. 


Mood: Excited to do Laura 2. It will probably be a traditional platformer.

notes.title: Quality of life additions
notes.notes:
We added some quality of life options to the game that were requested:

Now you can properly exit the game, toggle fullscreen and there is a new accessibility option: Auto run. You don't need to hold the run button anymore.

Thank you for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/4b46393b8475430d365d5589f24aa2228ab60738.png[/img]

notes.title: FAREWELL UPDATE
notes.notes:
In the last update we added online multiplayer so you could fall and rise together with friends, but one thing that was in my backlog and I was asked sometimes was about doing some sort of customization on laura.

In this update we're adding some hats for laura! There is over 30 hats for you to customize (and, if you're willing to mess with the games files, you'll be able to make your own hats yourself!)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/3cfe0499d8dd21540bd682e61400fecc1544d49d.gif[/img]

You can have a really looooooooooooooong hat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/5baf95c7e9c8077e0df7186eea5f50d5c043e9e1.gif[/img]

Or a flag of your like (we've had a very limited time to add hats and flags so I'm sorry if we didn't include your flag on the list of flags at our hats shop)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/2e07e10399236f9a24c834179c41d8819df3e1e1.gif[/img]

Also we added a cute little dog and you can pet it! Look at this cute little thing here

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/6f1f3b0ee78a8d55bf3b90e0091f78c59ee85a8e.gif[/img]

We've fixed a list of bugs and places you could get stuck (sorry about that!). 

Also Select button on your gamepad now restarts your game (as R in your keyboard).

And with all this we are probably finishing the dev cycle of the game atleast for game content this was all I had planned on the game. But it doesn't mean I'll abandon the game completely. If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to contact me or post them on the forums. I'm also thinking about doing temporary changes to the main level on special dates (halloween/xmas), but this is not a promise, It's just a little thought.

Not in the distant future:
We're launching the game on android. Without ads. Totally for free, although it'll have some form of call to action to the steam version which is the ideal way of giving me support right now besides seeing me dev on twitch.

notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a crash when using chatbox while offline
- Scores are sent for multiplayer (though at a really high value, just for people who finished the game being able to see scores)

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.notes:
Not much has been done in this update.  

 + Changed the connection menu order and added a message to warn people in game that playing online deactivates leaderboards. 
 + Minor fixes to collision
 + Adjustments to the camera button 

I'll stop for awhile updating this game as I already think everything is finished. There are some plans of adding some more features ingame such as hats and customization. But that will probably take sometime to get back to as I'm going back to other projects.

Thank you very much for playing the game!

notes.title: SUPER LAURA UP TOGETHER
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FxcvNycMe5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We added a little button at the start of the game that enables online play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/b356e4c693e80e3fb9737d5b6fff59d50b6abf51.png[/img]

Now you're able to help your friends and make them fall even harder with 4 different skills:

Repel, teleport, blocks and bullet!

Since these skills can make you skip most of the game HIGHSCORES ARE DISABLED AFTER YOU ENTER ONLINE MODE, you will need to close the game and open it again in order to compete in highscores again.

notes.title: Minor fixes for highscore names + Volume bar is saving
notes.notes:
+ Added a font to support japanese, russian, chinese and korean characters.
+ Now if you change volume on the pause menu, the volume should save between sessions.

notes.title: Minor fixes for camera
notes.notes:
The game launch was a success! Despite being a small developer, it was great to see friends playing and even receiving reviews from people on the other side of the world saying they want to punch me!


But yeah there are somethings that needed to be fixed such as camera issues. 

To some people this was the hardest jump just because of the camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/9c0e86e484259a04ca55cf2fd45d24b1eb484e17.png[/img]

Can you see where you should go? Me neither!

This update is changing the control panels to better teach the game buttons. There was a hidden mechanic that let you change your camera direction to where you're looking. by pressing V or "R1" or "RB" you could change your camera. But for some reason it didn't pass in my head that I needed to teach players of this. So yeah.... Now there is a panel that teaches everything at the same time. It's not beautiful but it's something needed and I could only do this way for now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/f9bab0d9e4a41e138c695127f04e42d7407a69d1.png[/img]

So now you should be able to see this withouth doing some clunky movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745116/96c46581797e709a26b1ad7de466dd3625322da7.png[/img]

At some time in the future I'll probably revisit this panel, because they are really ugly looking.

I'll be working into updating and releasing some new features. I won't promise anything right now, but I'm excited to update this game! But before doing new stuff, there are things that need fixing such as:

Highscore not showing for some players (they seem to be working only after finishing the game which isn't intended)
Highscore text doesn't contain characters for korean, russian, japanese and chinese language (I wasn't expecting for people to finish this game so quickly around the world! So thank you so much if you're reading this! And sorry if your name isn't being displayed in the game highscore)
